research: This path's own Data Governance Program Management course (program management rung: stakeholder management, roadmaps, KPIs, budget) and Data Governance Architecture course (architect rung: enterprise metadata architecture, catalog/lineage architecture across platforms, policy-as-code, governance automation) — this lesson maps the already-taught scope of those two courses onto a general career-ladder narrative rather than introducing new claims

General, widely-understood career-progression concepts (individual contributor to senior IC to manager to architect/staff-level track) applied directionally to data governance; no specific timeline, title, or compensation figures are claimed
note: Career-ladder lesson with no real product UI to screenshot. All slides are original LTV-authored steps diagrams and one original code-style summary card. No screenshots used or needed.
